title: Memory
description: View and manage memories saved on this device to continue your research and collaboration.
globalDescription: Read and update your personal background across projects. Turning this off stops reading and updating while keeping saved memories.
projectDescription: Read and update collaboration style, content and presentation requirements, research interests, plans and progress separately for each project. Turning this off stops reading and updating all project memories while keeping saved memories.
noProjects: Create a project to view its memories here.
clearDescription: Delete memories in this scope. Other memories, original conversations and research materials are kept. New conversations can generate memories if memory remains enabled.
filesDescription: Click a filename to preview; use the icon on the right to open it locally.
sessionDescription: Memories added or changed in this conversation
paused: Automatic reading and updating are off. Existing records are kept.
openUnavailable: Local files cannot be opened in this simulated environment.
openFailed: Unable to open the file. Check that it exists and has a default application.
